formulas.formula: Clients, jobs, crew pay and profit for your cleaning business.
Setup: business name, the year, your crew's usual pay, mileage rate, card fee, target margin and a monthly goal.
Clients: each customer with how often you clean and the usual price. Team: your cleaners and their hourly pay.
Jobs: one row per clean. Hours worked, extras, supplies and miles. Tick Paid when the money is in.
Expenses: bulk supplies, insurance, equipment and software.
Monthly, Price Quote and Dashboard show profit per job, per hour and what clients still owe.
Uses the client's usual price. Type a price for deep cleans and one-offs.
Means you did it. Your own pay rate is in Setup (0 = profit includes your pay).
What the business keeps for each hour worked, after pay and costs.
Price Quote estimates hours from size, rooms and job type. Adjust to your real speed.
Red = unpaid, loss or a typo.
Sparkling homes and a sparkling bottom line!
